name: Vivalto Santé
note: French private-hospital group founded in 2009 by Daniel Caille. Its controlling shareholder is Vivalto Partners (Daniel Caille's management company), alongside institutional investors (IK Partners, MACSF, Bpifrance, Mubadala, Arkéa Capital, Groupe Crédit Agricole, BNPP), more than 1,200 doctor shareholders and employee shareholders. The investors' stakes aren't published; the supervisory board includes representatives of the institutional shareholders.
